title: The full Claude Platform, available on Google Cloud
summary: Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed) are now generally available with the full Claude Platform feature set, billed on a single Google Cloud invoice that counts toward existing Google Cloud commitments. New features and betas such as Managed Agents (beta), code execution, computer use, caching, and batch are available on the same day, and Fast Mode on Claude Opus 5.5 is GA with up to 2.5x faster output. The Google-managed option remains available for Google-as-processor, regional residency, and Model Armor.

title: Introducing artifacts for legal work
summary: Claude for Legal gets a gallery of ready-to-use artifacts, such as trackers and dashboards, that teams can adapt, share, and connect to their own data. They cover cite checking, playbook deviation tracking, regulatory scans, and tabular contract review, with outputs linked to sources, plus 60+ legal connectors added since the May launch (including Bloomberg Law and Filevine). The release also includes nine access-to-justice artifacts, a Legal Ambassadors Program (waitlist), and sharing settings that support ethical walls, and lawyers still review all output.

title: Claude for Financial Advisors
summary: Claude for Financial Advisors is a suite of connectors and workflow skills for advisor research, meeting prep, and documentation, with new connectors for Charles Schwab, Addepar, Orion, and Wealthbox. A plugin bundles eight skills, including pre-meeting prep, follow-up, and rebalance review, and advisors approve critical tasks, CRM updates, and client communications, while a compliance skill checks against the SEC Marketing Rule. Enterprise plans are recommended for RIAs because of their audit logs.

title: Claude Duet Safety, Privacy, and Security
summary: Claude Duet is a proactive research-preview agent that works on a cloud computer even after the app is closed, and this post explains its safeguards. Sensitive actions show the action, destination, and content and wait for approval, some actions such as trading or moving money are always blocked, and a new classifier screens outgoing messages. The model never sees passwords, cookies, or tokens, and Anthropic acknowledges that safeguards will sometimes miss things.

title: LLMs are making formal software verification feasible at a much larger scale
summary: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team, working with Theorem, used Claude to write formal proofs of no-crash properties for 239 entry points across 123 open-source libraries at the compiled RISC-V assembly level. The work found and patched bugs that fuzzing had missed for years and was also applied to zlib, a Rust Python interpreter, and a PDF reader. It suggests formal verification could become routine rather than niche, though Anthropic cautions that "formally verified" does not mean bug-free.

title: Manage costs and demonstrate ROI for Claude Code on Google Cloud
summary: This Anthropic best-practices guide, inspired by a webinar with Google Cloud, frames cost management for Claude Code around three levers: control, track, and prove. Claude apps gateway offers spend caps per user, group, or org, model allowlists, and OpenTelemetry export to Cloud Monitoring or BigQuery, while suggested ROI metrics include adoption, satisfaction, PR cycle time, review turnaround, and merged work. It argues that cost per task matters more than per-token price for agentic tools.
